name: intents_adversarial
why: golden/intents.jsonl measures 1.0000, so it cannot show a regression. These rows hold the same four routes but make the PHRASING hard rather than the subject novel: terse fragments, verbose wrappers, negated openings, and intents stated without their keyword (a comparison with no 'compare', a summary with no 'summarise', a relation with no 'connect').
subjects: Invented and corpus-free, the same set the generalisation suite uses, so a route that depends on a corpus entity fails here rather than passing by memory.
excluded: Multi-intent questions ('summarise X and compare it to Y'). No single label is defensible, so such a row would measure the labeller rather than the router.
